===== english-brief.md =====
# Independent english-first proposal: C05:268–270

Read ../proposal-protocol.md in full and its required project instructions.
Source and context snapshots are beside this brief. Independently verify the
six selected snapshot fields against full original read-only spine rows.

Use only this angle. Write only english/268, english/269 and english/270.
Do not read other-angle, root-review-target, reconciliation or semantic files.
No delegation, repository/source/master edits, commits, browser/device/native
actions, web or paid APIs. Python bytecode disabled and SQLite URI mode=ro.

Read the complete local source argument and neighboring context before making
matches. Preserve useful defensible lexical coverage, exact repeated occurrences,
source roles and provisional producer labels. Full source text remains verbatim.
A null is an affirmative no-separate-exponent judgment; unresolved/distributed
translation stays omitted with an explicit reason. Any following selection
heading remains original apparatus under the registered class.

Deliver each final spec/body/report/errata, exact canonical stdout/stderr/exit,
measured counts and hashes, full material original evidence and all failed or
superseded attempts. No semantic approval is implied by a mechanical pass.
Freeze final files before reporting completion; any later correction must
preserve and explicitly supersede the prior frozen proof boundary.

Batch read whitelist: this angle brief, source.json, context.json, baseline.json
when root later creates it, and your own angle files. Do not glob or search the
batch parent directory; it contains withheld root and other-angle judgments.

===== prepare-semantic-supplement.py =====
"""Preserve complete material decisions and enumerate every raw input for review."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
target = b / 'semantic-input-supplement.txt'
assert not target.exists()
selected = set(p for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.md', '.json', '.diff', '.py'})
for folder in ('proposal-verification', 'root-reconciliation-verification'):
    selected.update(p for p in (b / folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
names = {
    'original-dispositions.json', 'final-decisions.json', 'errata-analysis.json',
    'unwrapped-extents.json', 'intended-spans.json', 'occurrences.json',
    'evidence-references.json', 'attempt-history.json', 'final-audit-addendum.json',
    'finalizer-execution-records.json', 'collection-proof.json',
    'proposed-span-head-allowances.json', 'pre-freeze-verification.json',
    'failed-source-capture-attempt01.json', 'physical-decode-failed-attempt.json',
    'input-proof.json', 'completion-input-proof.json', 'registered-class-check.json',
    'root-additional-query-reruns-full.json', 'original-replay-proof.json',
    'original-span-objects.json', 'supplement-proof.json',
    'practice7-physical-review.json', 'practice7-render-proof.json',
    'erratum-ascii-physical-extents.json', 'ILL-original-extents.json',
    'batch-counts.json', 'generator-proof.json',
}
for angle in ('tibetan', 'english', 'reconciled'):
    for seq in (268, 269, 270):
        selected.update(p for p in (b / angle / str(seq)).iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name in names)
chunks = ['This supplement contains full material decisions and provenance. Root authored the Tibetan originals; its checks are mechanical, not independent semantic approval. The separate reviewer must independently read all original raw evidence enumerated in semantic-all-inputs.json, including historical versions and failed attempts. No final output is accepted yet.\n']
manifest = []
for p in sorted(selected):
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    chunks.extend(['\n===== '+str(p.relative_to(b))+' =====\n', raw.decode('utf-8')])
    manifest.append({'path': str(p.relative_to(b)), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
chunks.extend(['\n===== COMPLETE SUPPLEMENT MANIFEST =====\n', json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), '\n'])
target.write_text(''.join(chunks))
all_inputs = []
for p in sorted(b.rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and 'semantic-review' not in p.parts:
        raw = p.read_bytes()
        all_inputs.append({'path': str(p), 'relative_path': str(p.relative_to(b)), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
(b / 'semantic-all-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_inputs, indent=2)+'\n')
result = {'supplement_bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'supplement_sha256': hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'complete_material_files': len(manifest), 'all_raw_input_files': len(all_inputs)}
(b / 'semantic-supplement-generation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

# Proposal-role capacity ruling for C05:268–270

Ruling: Use primary Codex as Tibetan-first original author and reuse
/root/c05_262_264_english for English-first. Reserve
/root/c05_253_255_reconcile as non-author reconciler and
/root/c05_through249_final_review as a different non-author semantic reviewer
after its fixed through267 checkpoint closes. The platform retains only three
child records; its previous fresh-instance request failed. Two child authors
would leave one non-author for two independent review roles. This explicit
workflow-constraint ruling departs from the SDD preference for a controller-only
primary and fresh author instances while preserving four distinct current roles.

Primary Codex already prepared this batch's source/glossary leads and openly
credits its own prior preparation. It has seen no English268–270 proposal.
It may read its own preparation, but must not open English proposals, reports
or judgments until all three Tibetan originals freeze. English may read only
its angle's whitelist plus this nonsemantic ruling; root leads and Tibetan
files remain withheld. English's completion message must contain only status,
counts, hashes and paths until both angles freeze. Semantic findings belong in
private reports; mechanical access blockers can be raised immediately.

Cost if wrong: prior preparation can bias the primary proposal, and author/
controller combination removes an additional independent root perspective.
Mitigate with peer-output isolation, exact full original evidence and immutable
freezes, actual canonical checks and two distinct non-author reviews before
acceptance. No fresh-context claim and no omitted source, semantic, fidelity or
provenance gate. Neither original author may reconcile or semantically approve
this batch. Preserve and independently review any correction to a frozen draft.

Baseline f3c1ca804a933d53f84214d6968a84e7e0193c6e was captured from the clean
through267 data commit before documentation. Current governing documentation
is2a1b9a8f5203ff38cf7b9ae83186e0bf433c3812. Fixed through267 review is active;
original work can overlap its read-only checking of immutable source/master.
No next landing until that checkpoint closes. If preceding data changes, keep
consumed snapshots intact and explicitly supersede the baseline before landing.

Read full shared proposal protocol, assigned angle brief and required project
sources. Preserve all source text verbatim, provisional producer labels and
failed attempts. No repository/source/master edits, paid APIs, web, account
messages, native/device/browser actions, commits or subdelegation in either
original role. SQLite URI mode=ro and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 in all processes.

# C05:268–270 reconciliation requirements

Read the worktree's AGENTS.md, docs/ALIGNMENT_LAYER_SPEC.md,
docs/alignment_briefs/RECONCILE_BRIEF.md and REFUTE_BRIEF.md, and the C05
course shape. The authorized Codex handover supersedes historical model names.
All eight required reference directories are readable.

Worktree: /Users/adamderickandrade/Documents/ChatGPT/Geshe Michael Roach Tib _ Eng Alignment/campaign-worktree.
All repository, source and master files are read-only for this role. Use SQLite
URI mode=ro and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. No agents, commits, paid APIs,
native/device/browser actions, or repository edits.

Read source.json and context.json beside this brief and independently reopen
the original spine rows. Read both complete proposals in tibetan/{268,269,270}/
and english/{268,269,270}/. Replay all six actual canonical generators and
compare saved bodies. Reopen supporting glossary fields and corpus witnesses;
proposal agreement is not semantic proof. The root's proposal-verification and
parallel/lexical checks are additional evidence, never substitutes for originals.

Write only reconciled/{268,269,270}/ beside this brief, with separate one-segment
spec.json, body.html, errata.json and report.md. Preserve failed attempts and
prior versions. Each report must explain material disagreements, selected
occurrences and omissions, actual generator exit and final spec/body hashes and
byte counts. Save complete original evidence for material claims. Re-run the
generator and refresh all outputs after every note or spec change.

Preserve GMR's wording verbatim and PROVISIONAL labels, identifying the actual
producer. Leave no stale pending-review statement in canonical notes. A separate
skeptical reader must approve before root lands any result.

Retain defensible useful lexical coverage. d5 is a word or established compound;
d7 is a unique tighter member immediately after its d5 parent, with English
inside the parent. Full recasts may be d3 when the complete source relation
licenses the whole English phrase. Depth cannot conceal a false mapping.
Exclude supplied participants, articles, auxiliaries and hinges. A null means
no separately alignable exponent, including proven grammatical fusion with an
explicit note; uncertainty or distributed content is omitted with a reason.
Check every repeated source occurrence with canonical ranges and eng_order.

For each d5/d7 gated English head, name its actual Tibetan licensor and report
the exact proposed allowance; do not edit the allowance file or relax a gate.
For every retained erratum, check all five refutation grounds, all original
quotes and claimed counts, and already registered classes. Digital equality or
difference does not prove independent publication or ingestion lineage. Short
parallels support only their shared extent. Keep confidence limited by evidence.
An empty errata list is valid. No source correction or hgm_gloss promotion.

Return concise status, per-segment counts, generator proof, concerns and report
paths. All detailed decisions and evidence belong on disk.


## Required decision coverage

Reopen the original sources behind its leads. Record a disposition for every
original proposed span, preserving original IDs, depth, words and occurrence

===== root-reconciliation-verification/boundary-attempt01.py.txt =====
"""Mechanical root handoff check. Root authored Tibetan; no semantic approval."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import datetime, hashlib, json, sqlite3, subprocess

b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
wt = b.parent.parent / 'campaign-worktree'
out = b / 'root-reconciliation-verification'
target = out / 'root-frozen-evidence-check.json'
assert not target.exists(), 'Preserve any earlier boundary check before retry.'
key7 = ('seq','id','d','tib','eng','tib_range','eng_range')
key8 = ('angle',) + key7
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def pin(p):
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def same_pin(p,e):
    assert pin(p)=={k:e[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')},str(p)
def git_bytes(commit,path):
    return subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{commit}:{path}'],cwd=wt,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=wt,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
assert head=='2487bfcd73a1463d135a4544a01535ba5c99cab0'
baseline=read(b/'baseline.json')
for name,sha in baseline['sha256'].items():
    assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==sha
    assert hashlib.sha256(git_bytes(baseline['commit'],name)).hexdigest()==sha
db=sqlite3.connect((wt/'build/hgm_spine_v27_2.db').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
sources=[dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM corpus_segments WHERE course=? AND seq BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY seq',('C05',268,270))]
db.close()
assert sources==read(b/'reconciled/268/source-full-rows.json')
assert [{k:r[k] for k in ('id','course','seq','acip','wylie','english')} for r in sources]==read(b/'source.json')
root_originals=read(b/'proposal-verification/root-resolved-spans.json')
root_finals=read(out/'resolved-spans.json')
assert len(root_originals)==227 and len(root_finals)==123
original_by_key={(x['angle'],x['seq'],x['id']):x for x in root_originals}
assert len(original_by_key)==len(root_originals)
frozen=[]; dispositions=Counter(); seen=[]; final_reasons=set(); original_reasons=set()
for seq in (268,269,270):
    d=b/'reconciled'/str(seq); freeze=read(d/'freeze.json')
    expected={e['relative_path'] for e in freeze['files']}
    actual={str(p.relative_to(d)) for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=d/'freeze.json'}
    assert actual==expected and len(expected)==freeze['file_count']
    assert sum(e['bytes'] for e in freeze['files'])==freeze['total_bytes']
    for e in freeze['files']:
        assert Path(e['path'])==(d/e['relative_path']).resolve()
        same_pin(Path(e['path']),e)
    frozen.append(dict(seq=seq,files=len(expected),freeze=pin(d/'freeze.json')))
    spec=read(d/'spec.json'); seg=spec['segments'][0]
    final=[x for x in root_finals if x['seq']==seq]
    assert read(d/'resolved-spans.json')==final
    assert all(set(x)==set(key7) for x in final)
    decisions=read(d/'final-decisions.json')
    assert [x['final_tuple'] for x in decisions]==final
    assert [x['final_span'] for x in decisions]==seg['spans']
    final_reasons.update(x['rationale'] for x in decisions)
    for x in decisions:
        assert x['rationale'] and x['independent_basis']
        for path in x['evidence']: assert (d/path).is_file(),path
    source=next(x for x in sources if x['seq']==seq)
    gaps=read(d/'unwrapped-extents.json')
    for field,range_key in [('wylie','tib_range'),('english','eng_range')]:
        text=source[field]; covered=[False]*len(text)
        for t in final:
            r=t[range_key]
            if r is None: continue
            a,z=r; assert 0<=a<z<=len(text)
            assert text[a:z]==t['tib' if field=='wylie' else 'eng']
            covered[a:z]=[True]*(z-a)
        actual_gaps=[];i=0
        while i<len(text):
            if covered[i]:i+=1;continue
            j=i+1
            while j<len(text) and not covered[j]:j+=1
            actual_gaps.append(dict(range=[i,j],text=text[i:j]));i=j
        assert actual_gaps==gaps[field]
    for x in read(d/'original-dispositions.json'):
        original=x['original_identity'];assert set(original)==set(key8)
        k=(original['angle'],original['seq'],original['id']);seen.append(k)
        r=original_by_key[k];assert original=={a:r[a] for a in key8}
        p=b/original['angle']/str(seq)/'spec.json'
        span=next(t for t in read(p)['segments'][0]['spans'] if t['id']==original['id'])
        assert x['original_span']==span==r['original_span']
        assert x['original_span_keys']==list(span)
        assert x['original_field_presence']==sorted(span)==r['original_field_presence']
        assert Path(x['original_spec_path'])==p.resolve()
        assert x['reason'];original_reasons.add(x['reason'])
        disposition=x['disposition'];dispositions[disposition]+=1
        assert disposition in ('retained','recast','rejected')
        for f in x['final_identities']:assert f in final
        if disposition=='retained':
            assert len(x['final_identities'])==1
            f=x['final_identities'][0]
            assert {a:original[a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}=={a:f[a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}
        elif disposition=='rejected':assert not x['final_identities']
        else:assert x['final_identities']
assert len(seen)==len(set(seen))==227 and set(seen)==set(original_by_key)
assert dispositions==Counter(retained=200,recast=26,rejected=1)
shared=b/'reconciled/268'
mappings=[]
for name in ('original-to-copy-manifest.json','supplemental-to-copy-manifest.json','helper-and-skill-copy-manifest.json'):
    mappings+=read(shared/name)
mappings+=read(shared/'freeze-packaging-addendum.json')['additional_source_to_copy_mappings']
assert len(mappings)==221
whitelist={'.json','.md','.html','.stderr','.stdout','.log','.txt','.bin','.exit'}
historical=0
for e in mappings:
    copy=shared/e['copy'];same_pin(copy,e);assert copy.suffix in whitelist
    if 'original_git_commit' in e:
        raw=git_bytes(e['original_git_commit'],e['repository_relative_path']);historical+=1
    else:raw=Path(e['original']).read_bytes()
    assert copy.read_bytes()==raw and len(raw)==e['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==e['sha256']
assert historical==10
status=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=wt,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
assert status=='?? data/teaching/dcc_captions\n'
result=dict(utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),status='PASS mechanical handoff only',head=head,baseline=baseline['commit'],nine_baseline_hashes_equal_live_and_original_Git=True,source_rows_exact=True,reconciliation_freezes=frozen,original_identities=227,dispositions=dict(dispositions),final_tuples=123,nulls=5,nonnull_d5=75,full_original_fields_preserved=True,complete_unwrapped_complements_exact=True,all_final_rationales_and_omissions_read=True,all_original_reason_texts_represented_by_read_final_rationales_or_additional_three=True,additional_original_reason_texts=len(original_reasons-final_reasons),material_mappings=221,historical_Git_pins=historical,all_material_copies_exact=True,all_material_copy_suffixes_supported=True,generator_reports=read(out/'report.json'),scope=status,limitations=['Root authored Tibetan; no independent semantic approval.', 'All three reports,123 final rationales,3 additional original reason texts,omissions and current five-ground rulings read. Earlier full original proposals remain frozen.','Full original physical witnesses and raw query archives are preserved and pinned. Separate reviewer must reopen them independently; root does not claim independent PDF visual review.','Retained probable erratum remains a candidate; no source/master/register/allowance or repository edits.'])
assert result['additional_original_reason_texts']==3
target.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['generator_reports','limitations']},ensure_ascii=False))

    decisions=read(d/'final-decisions.json')
    assert [x['final_tuple'] for x in decisions]==final
    assert [x['final_span'] for x in decisions]==seg['spans']

    for x in decisions:
        assert x['rationale'] and x['independent_basis']
        for path in x['evidence']: assert (d/path).is_file(),path
    source=next(x for x in sources if x['seq']==seq)
    gaps=read(d/'unwrapped-extents.json')
    for field,range_key in [('wylie','tib_range'),('english','eng_range')]:
        text=source[field]; covered=[False]*len(text)
        for t in final:
            r=t[range_key]
            if r is None: continue
            a,z=r; assert 0<=a<z<=len(text)
            assert text[a:z]==t['tib' if field=='wylie' else 'eng']
            covered[a:z]=[True]*(z-a)
        actual_gaps=[];i=0
        while i<len(text):
            if covered[i]:i+=1;continue
            j=i+1
            while j<len(text) and not covered[j]:j+=1
            actual_gaps.append(dict(range=[i,j],text=text[i:j]));i=j
        assert actual_gaps==gaps[field]
    for x in read(d/'original-dispositions.json'):
        original=x['original_identity'];assert set(original)==set(key8)

        span=next(t for t in read(p)['segments'][0]['spans'] if t['id']==original['id'])
        assert x['original_span']==span==r['original_span']
        assert x['original_span_keys']==list(span)
        assert x['original_field_presence']==sorted(span)==r['original_field_presence']
        assert Path(x['original_spec_path'])==p.resolve()
        assert x['reason'];original_reasons.add(x['reason'])
        disposition=x['disposition'];dispositions[disposition]+=1
        assert disposition in ('retained','recast','rejected')
        for f in x['final_identities']:assert f in final
        if disposition=='retained':
            assert len(x['final_identities'])==1
            f=x['final_identities'][0]
            assert {a:original[a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}=={a:f[a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}
        elif disposition=='rejected':assert not x['final_identities']
        else:assert x['final_identities']
assert len(seen)==len(set(seen))==227 and set(seen)==set(original_by_key)

===== tibetan-brief.md =====
# Independent tibetan-first proposal: C05:268–270

Read ../proposal-protocol.md in full and its required project instructions.
Source and context snapshots are beside this brief. Independently verify the
six selected snapshot fields against full original read-only spine rows.

Use only this angle. Write only tibetan/268, tibetan/269 and tibetan/270.
Do not read other-angle, root-review-target, reconciliation or semantic files.
No delegation, repository/source/master edits, commits, browser/device/native
actions, web or paid APIs. Python bytecode disabled and SQLite URI mode=ro.

Read the complete local source argument and neighboring context before making
matches. Preserve useful defensible lexical coverage, exact repeated occurrences,
source roles and provisional producer labels. Full source text remains verbatim.
A null is an affirmative no-separate-exponent judgment; unresolved/distributed
translation stays omitted with an explicit reason. Any following selection
heading remains original apparatus under the registered class.

Deliver each final spec/body/report/errata, exact canonical stdout/stderr/exit,
measured counts and hashes, full material original evidence and all failed or
superseded attempts. No semantic approval is implied by a mechanical pass.
Freeze final files before reporting completion; any later correction must
preserve and explicitly supersede the prior frozen proof boundary.

Batch read whitelist: this angle brief, source.json, context.json, baseline.json
when root later creates it, and your own angle files. Do not glob or search the
batch parent directory; it contains withheld root and other-angle judgments.

===== verify-current-original-boundaries.py =====
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, datetime, sys, importlib.util
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
batch=Path(__file__).parent
wt=batch.parents[1]/'campaign-worktree'
sys.path.insert(0,str(wt/'tools'))
definition=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('canonical_generator',wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py')
g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(definition);definition.loader.exec_module(g)
src={x['seq']:x for x in json.loads((batch/'source.json').read_text())}
records=[];freezes=[]
for angle in ['tibetan','english']:
    for seq in [268,269,270]:
        d=batch/angle/str(seq);f=json.loads((d/'freeze.json').read_text());fs=f['files']
        expected=fs if isinstance(fs,dict) else {x['path']:x for x in fs}
        actual={str(p.relative_to(d)) for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=d/'freeze.json'}
        assert actual==set(expected),(angle,seq,actual^set(expected))
        for name,x in expected.items():
            raw=(d/name).read_bytes();assert len(raw)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['sha256'],(angle,seq,name)
        s=json.loads((d/'spec.json').read_text())['segments'][0];spans=s['spans'];byid={x['id']:x for x in spans}
        tr=g.resolve(src[seq]['wylie'],spans,'tib',seq)
        ordered=g.with_members(spans,[byid[x] for x in s['eng_order']],src[seq]['english'])
        er=g.resolve(src[seq]['english'],ordered,'eng',seq)
        for x in spans:
            ident=x['id'];records.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,id=ident,d=x['d'],tib=x['tib'],eng=x['eng'],tib_range=list(tr[ident]),eng_range=None if x['eng'] is None else list(er[ident]),original_span=x,original_field_presence=sorted(x)))
        freezes.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,files=len(expected),freeze_sha256=hashlib.sha256((d/'freeze.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
assert len(records)==227
out=batch/'proposal-verification'
for name,obj in [('root-resolved-spans.json',records),('root-original-freeze-check.json',dict(utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),status='PASS six exact original freezes and227 actual identities',freezes=freezes,root_role='Primary authored Tibetan; this is mechanical evidence only. Separate non-author reconciliation and semantic approval required.'))]:
    with (out/name).open('x') as f:json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(freezes,indent=2))

===== verify-reconciliation-boundary.py =====
"""Mechanical root handoff check. Root authored Tibetan; no semantic approval."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import datetime, hashlib, json, sqlite3, subprocess

b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
wt = b.parent.parent / 'campaign-worktree'
out = b / 'root-reconciliation-verification'
target = out / 'root-frozen-evidence-check.json'
assert not target.exists(), 'Preserve any earlier boundary check before retry.'
key7 = ('seq','id','d','tib','eng','tib_range','eng_range')
key8 = ('angle',) + key7
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def pin(p):
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def same_pin(p,e):
    assert pin(p)=={k:e[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')},str(p)
def git_bytes(commit,path):
    return subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{commit}:{path}'],cwd=wt,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=wt,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
assert head=='2487bfcd73a1463d135a4544a01535ba5c99cab0'
baseline=read(b/'baseline.json')
fixture_names={'data/hgm_dictionary_v27_2.json.gz','data/full_parallel_corpus_v32.json.gz'}
for name,sha in baseline['sha256'].items():
    assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==sha
    if name not in fixture_names:
        assert hashlib.sha256(git_bytes(baseline['commit'],name)).hexdigest()==sha
    else:
        tracked=subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--error-unmatch','--',name],cwd=wt,capture_output=True)
        assert tracked.returncode==1, 'Expected external immutable fixture, not tracked data'
for e in read(b/'reconciled/268/final-audit.json')['checks'][0]['detail']:
    same_pin(Path(e['path']),e)
db=sqlite3.connect((wt/'build/hgm_spine_v27_2.db').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
sources=[dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM corpus_segments WHERE course=? AND seq BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY seq',('C05',268,270))]
db.close()
assert sources==read(b/'reconciled/268/source-full-rows.json')
assert [{k:r[k] for k in ('id','course','seq','acip','wylie','english')} for r in sources]==read(b/'source.json')
root_originals=read(b/'proposal-verification/root-resolved-spans.json')
root_finals=read(out/'resolved-spans.json')
assert len(root_originals)==227 and len(root_finals)==123
original_by_key={(x['angle'],x['seq'],x['id']):x for x in root_originals}
assert len(original_by_key)==len(root_originals)
frozen=[]; dispositions=Counter(); seen=[]; final_reasons=set(); original_reasons=set()
for seq in (268,269,270):
    d=b/'reconciled'/str(seq); freeze=read(d/'freeze.json')
    expected={e['relative_path'] for e in freeze['files']}
    actual={str(p.relative_to(d)) for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=d/'freeze.json'}
    assert actual==expected and len(expected)==freeze['file_count']
    assert sum(e['bytes'] for e in freeze['files'])==freeze['total_bytes']
    for e in freeze['files']:
        assert Path(e['path'])==(d/e['relative_path']).resolve()
        same_pin(Path(e['path']),e)
    frozen.append(dict(seq=seq,files=len(expected),freeze=pin(d/'freeze.json')))
    spec=read(d/'spec.json'); seg=spec['segments'][0]
    final=[x for x in root_finals if x['seq']==seq]
    assert read(d/'resolved-spans.json')==final
    assert all(set(x)==set(key7) for x in final)
    decisions=read(d/'final-decisions.json')
    assert [x['final_tuple'] for x in decisions]==final
    assert [x['final_span'] for x in decisions]==seg['spans']
    final_reasons.update(x['rationale'] for x in decisions)
    for x in decisions:
        assert x['rationale'] and x['independent_basis']
        for path in x['evidence']: assert (d/path).is_file(),path
    source=next(x for x in sources if x['seq']==seq)
    gaps=read(d/'unwrapped-extents.json')
    for field,range_key in [('wylie','tib_range'),('english','eng_range')]:
        text=source[field]; covered=[False]*len(text)
        for t in final:
            r=t[range_key]
            if r is None: continue
            a,z=r; assert 0<=a<z<=len(text)
            assert text[a:z]==t['tib' if field=='wylie' else 'eng']
            covered[a:z]=[True]*(z-a)
        actual_gaps=[];i=0
        while i<len(text):
            if covered[i]:i+=1;continue
            j=i+1
            while j<len(text) and not covered[j]:j+=1
            actual_gaps.append(dict(range=[i,j],text=text[i:j]));i=j
        assert actual_gaps==gaps[field]
    for x in read(d/'original-dispositions.json'):
        original=x['original_identity'];assert set(original)==set(key8)
        k=(original['angle'],original['seq'],original['id']);seen.append(k)
        r=original_by_key[k];assert original=={a:r[a] for a in key8}
        p=b/original['angle']/str(seq)/'spec.json'
        span=next(t for t in read(p)['segments'][0]['spans'] if t['id']==original['id'])
